items.title: Ruth & Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Saddle River, New Jersey, January 19, 2015
items.q: Benny was very nice to us. And he visited us after.

ctx.x: They weren’t babies, but they went to school right here in town. And my mother loved it. And even the kids said they had such a good time with her. And they’ll never forget it. And six weeks — and it was really great. Benny was very nice to us. And he visited us after.
Yeah he came and slept here a few times.
